PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "public\\images\\portfolio projects" -Recurse -File | Get-FileHash -Algorithm MD5 | Group-Object Hash | Where-Object Count -gt 1 | ForEach-Object { $_.Group.Path; "---" })

PowerShell($files = Get-ChildItem "public\\images" -Recurse -File; $total = \($files | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB; "Total: {0:N1} MB across {1} files" -f $total, $files.Count; $files | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 12 | ForEach-Object { "{0,8:N0} KB  {1}" -f \($_.Length/1KB\), $_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\public', ''\) })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; try { $runs = Invoke-RestMethod "https://api.github.com/repos/vinciscontact/creativedge/actions/runs?per_page=3" -ErrorAction Stop; $runs.workflow_runs | Select-Object name, status, conclusion, html_url | Format-List } catch { "API says: $\($_.Exception.Message\) \(repo may be private - check the Actions tab manually\)" })

PowerShell($jobs = Invoke-RestMethod "https://api.github.com/repos/vinciscontact/creativedge/actions/runs/28585467019/jobs"; $jobs.jobs | ForEach-Object { "JOB: $\($_.name\) -> $\($_.conclusion\)"; $_.steps | Where-Object { $_.conclusion -eq 'failure' } | ForEach-Object { "  FAILED STEP: $\($_.name\)" } })

PowerShell($runs = Invoke-RestMethod "https://api.github.com/repos/vinciscontact/creativedge/actions/runs?per_page=5"; $runs.workflow_runs | Select-Object name, status, conclusion, run_started_at, html_url | Format-List; try { Invoke-RestMethod "https://api.github.com/repos/vinciscontact/creativedge/pages" -ErrorAction Stop } catch { "Pages API: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\) - Pages likely not enabled yet" })

PowerShell($env:VITE_BASE='/creativedge/'; $env:VITE_SITE_URL='https://vinciscontact.github.io/creativedge'; npm run build; $env:VITE_BASE=$null; $env:VITE_SITE_URL=$null; New-Item -ItemType File -Path "dist\\.nojekyll" -Force | Out-Null; "dist ready: $\(Test-Path 'dist\\index.html'\) / 404: $\(Test-Path 'dist\\404.html'\)")

PowerShell(git commit -m "Deploy via gh-pages branch instead of Pages artifact flow" -m "Branch mode works with the default Pages setting - no manual enablement of the Actions source needed." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

PowerShell(try { $p = Invoke-RestMethod "https://api.github.com/repos/vinciscontact/creativedge/pages" -ErrorAction Stop; "Pages ENABLED: $\($p.html_url\) source=$\($p.source.branch\)/$\($p.source.path\) status=$\($p.status\)" } catch { "Pages not auto-enabled yet" }; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest "https://vinciscontact.github.io/creativedge/" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; "Site responds: HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "Site fetch: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $img = Invoke-WebRequest "https://vinciscontact.github.io/creativedge/images/hero%20background.webp" -Method Head -UseBasicParsing; "hero image: HTTP $\($img.StatusCode\) \($\($img.Headers.'Content-Type'\)\)" } catch { "hero image failed: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; try { Invoke-WebRequest "https://vinciscontact.github.io/creativedge/no-such-page" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; "unknown path: HTTP 200 \(unexpected\)" } catch { "unknown path: HTTP $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\) \(404.html served\)" })
